h: Davido's reaction as a DJ plays a Wizkid song at Zlatan Ibile's wedding gets fans talking
p: A DJ reportedly played a Wizkid track at Zlatan Ibile's wedding, and Davido's reaction in the moment has been shared widely. Fans are debating what his expression meant.
more: Clips of the moment are circulating on social media.
Fans of both singers have joined the debate.
